beats.label: S1 · Alone in Tucson
beats.text: Tandy Miller has spent months alone in his hometown of Tucson believing he is the last man on Earth; just as he tries to end his life, he finds Carol Pilbasian.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the premise, the show's central loneliness, and the arrival of the woman who will define Tandy's arc.

beats.label: S1 · Marriage of convenience
beats.text: Carol insists they marry to repopulate the Earth, and Tandy reluctantly agrees — then Melissa Chartres arrives, and he immediately schemes to sleep with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Tandy–Carol marriage and Tandy's chronic infidelity, the engine of the ensemble's future conflict.

beats.label: S1 · Todd joins
beats.text: Todd arrives and pairs with Melissa, ending Tandy's plans; Tandy spends months as the annoying fifth wheel in Carol's cul-de-sac.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Todd, a load-bearing ensemble member, and locks in the Todd–Melissa pairing that drives later chair-swaps.

beats.label: S1 · Erica and Gail arrive
beats.text: Two more survivors, Erica and Gail, arrive; Tandy claims to be single but is exposed, and Carol briefly divorces him before forgiving him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Completes the core ensemble and establishes Tandy's dishonesty as his defining trait heading into the leadership shakeup.

beats.label: S1 · The other Phil Miller
beats.text: A second, handsome, competent Phil Miller arrives; the group renames the original 'Tandy' and elects the newcomer as their leader, and Carol sleeps with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the alpha rival who will banish Tandy; permanently renames the protagonist; explains Carol's next choice.

beats.label: S1 · Banishment
beats.text: Tandy plots to kill Phil for taking Carol; Phil overhears, drives him to the desert, and threatens to kill him if he returns — but Carol chooses Tandy and leaves with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's rupture: ejects Tandy from the group and pairs him with Carol on the road, which is exactly where S2 begins.

beats.label: S1 · A brother in space
beats.text: As Tandy and Carol drive away, Tandy tells Carol he has a brother — Mike, an astronaut alive but stranded alone on the International Space Station.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's biggest reveal; opens an entirely separate storyline that runs through the next season.

cliffhanger.text: Tandy has been banished from Tucson under threat of death; he and Carol are together on the open road with no destination. Meanwhile, Tandy's brother Mike is alive and completely alone on the International Space Station.
questions: Will Tandy and Carol ever find their way back to the group?
Can Mike find a way home to Earth?
Is the new Phil now the group's permanent leader?

characters.name: Phil "Tandy" Miller
characters.line: Petty, selfish everyman; just banished from Tucson and driving off with his wife Carol.

characters.name: Carol Pilbasian
characters.line: Eccentric, rule-loving survivor who married Tandy on principle and chose him over the group when he was cast out.

characters.name: Melissa Chartres
characters.line: Beautiful blonde survivor paired with Todd in the cul-de-sac.

characters.name: Todd Rodriguez
characters.line: Kind, unassuming, heavyset man paired with Melissa and quietly loyal to Tandy.

characters.name: Erica Dundee
characters.line: Australian survivor, currently interested in the new Phil.

characters.name: Gail Klosterman
characters.line: Older, hard-drinking survivor also interested in the new Phil.

characters.name: Phil "New Phil" Miller
characters.line: Handsome, competent ex–Special Forces builder elected leader, who later banishes Tandy from Tucson.

characters.name: Mike Miller
characters.line: Tandy's brother, alive but stranded on the International Space Station.

beats.label: S2 · Return to Malibu
beats.text: After six months on the road with Carol, Tandy tracks the group to Malibu — where Carol's sudden appearance startles a new survivor, Gordon, into a fatal heart attack.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the split leads with the ensemble and moves the show to its S2–S3 setting.

beats.label: S2 · Tandy in the pillory
beats.text: The group locks Tandy up for threatening them at gunpoint, and only Carol stands by him through weeks in a pillory and a shock collar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Tandy's outcast status inside the group and Carol as his sole defender.

beats.label: S2 · Phil returns, Erica pregnant
beats.text: New Phil rejoins the group as the outcast this time; after weeks of hostility, Erica announces she is pregnant with his baby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Erica's pregnancy, the season's central baby storyline that carries into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Phil dies
beats.text: Todd and Gail secretly begin an affair; on Christmas Day, Phil suddenly collapses and dies from an untreated appendix during Gail's attempt to operate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the alpha rival, leaves Erica's baby fatherless, and fractures the Todd–Melissa pairing.

beats.label: S2 · The Todd arrangement
beats.text: After Phil's death Melissa and Gail eventually agree to share Todd rather than fight over him, forming a permanent three-way.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the stable Todd–Melissa–Gail configuration heading into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Mike lands, Carol pregnant
beats.text: Tandy's astronaut brother Mike arrives on Earth; hiding his low sperm count, Tandy insists Mike marry Carol in his place — and Carol soon becomes pregnant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Family reunion and second pregnancy; the twin S3 setups. Everyone assumes the baby is Tandy's.

beats.label: S2 · Mike gone, Pat arrives
beats.text: Mike coughs up blood and disappears in the night rather than risk infecting anyone; days later, Pat Brown lands on the beach with two armed men in hazmat suits.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Exact S3 cliffhanger — a missing brother, a possible virus outbreak, and an armed unknown at the door.

cliffhanger.text: Pat Brown has landed on Malibu's beach with two armed men in hazmat suits. Carol is pregnant with what everyone believes is Tandy's baby, Erica with the late Phil's, and Mike has vanished into the desert possibly carrying the virus.
questions: Who is Pat Brown and what does he want?
Is Mike still alive out there?
Can the group hold onto Malibu now?

characters.name: Phil "Tandy" Miller
characters.line: Back with the group in Malibu after his banishment, married to Carol, and expecting what he believes is his own baby.

characters.name: Carol Pilbasian
characters.line: Pregnant with a child everyone (including her) believes is Tandy's; his one constant defender.

characters.name: Erica Dundee
characters.line: Heavily pregnant with the deceased Phil's baby.

characters.name: Todd Rodriguez
characters.line: Now in an open triangle with both Melissa and Gail.

characters.name: Melissa Chartres
characters.line: Sharing Todd with Gail; recently paranoid and irritable, once nearly shot Carol in the night.

characters.name: Gail Klosterman
characters.line: Sharing Todd with Melissa; still keeps a Gordon mannequin for company.

characters.name: Mike Miller
characters.line: Tandy's brother; landed from space, coughed blood, and disappeared to spare the group from possible infection.

characters.name: Phil "New Phil" (Stacy) Miller
characters.line: Handy builder who put up the group's solar panels; died on Christmas of a burst appendix; father of Erica's unborn child.

characters.name: Pat Brown
characters.line: Grizzled sailor and virus-conspiracy paranoid; just arrived at Malibu with two armed men in hazmat suits.

beats.label: S3 · Malibu falls
beats.text: Pat's crew lands; Melissa kills one, Pat recognises Mike in a family photo and turns on the group, and Todd runs him over as they flee Malibu.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Malibu era, apparently kills Pat (who reappears), and haunts Melissa for the rest of the season.

beats.label: S3 · The office complex
beats.text: The group settles into a self-sustaining office building in San Jose; Gail is accidentally trapped in an elevator for weeks with no one realising she's missing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New setting for the season and launches Gail's isolated arc that runs quietly in parallel to the main plot.

beats.label: S3 · Lewis flies and dies
beats.text: Lewis, mourning his lost partner Mark in Tokyo, teaches himself to fly; Tandy pushes him into a real plane and Lewis crashes and dies on take-off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First death of a group member the audience knew well; Tandy carries the guilt into the next season.

beats.label: S3 · Melissa unravels
beats.text: Melissa slowly breaks down from having killed Darrell — she wanders, she runs away, and Gail eventually identifies her medication as antipsychotics.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Melissa's condition and her fragile recovery are a running thread through the last third of the season and into S4.

beats.label: S3 · A silent boy in a mask
beats.text: A silent boy in a Yoda mask appears and joins the group; Tandy names him Jasper, but the boy latches onto Erica instead of him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jasper, a new member of the group whose bond with Erica shapes S4 dynamics.

beats.label: S3 · Dawn is born
beats.text: Erica gives birth to a daughter, Dawn; Erica and Gail pair off as a couple, Melissa and Todd marry, and Carol is now visibly pregnant too.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's first successful birth; the couple configurations that carry into S4 all lock into place here.

beats.label: S3 · Meltdown and Pamela
beats.text: A nearby nuclear plant melts down, so the group flees south by yacht; Pat catches them at a marina, but a stranger named Pamela Brinton shoots him dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Forces the relocation to Mexico and introduces the wealthy stranger who dominates the next season.

cliffhanger.text: The group is on a yacht fleeing a nuclear meltdown, just saved from a returning Pat Brown by a wealthy stranger, Pamela Brinton, whom none of them have ever met.
questions: Where will the group settle now that California is unlivable?
Will Carol's baby be born safely on the run?

characters.name: Phil "Tandy" Miller
characters.line: On the fleeing yacht with a pregnant Carol; still the group's manic center, now carrying guilt for Lewis's death.

characters.name: Carol Pilbasian
characters.line: Heavily pregnant on the yacht, escaping radiation with the group.

characters.name: Erica Dundee
characters.line: New mother of baby Dawn; now romantically partnered with Gail.

characters.name: Gail Klosterman
characters.line: Partnered with Erica and adoptive mother to Carol; just escaped weeks trapped alone in an elevator.

characters.name: Todd Rodriguez
characters.line: Now married to Melissa; helped deliver Dawn as the group's makeshift doctor's assistant.

characters.name: Melissa Chartres
characters.line: Recovered from a psychotic break triggered by killing Darrell; now on antipsychotics and married to Todd.

characters.name: Jasper
characters.line: Silent preadolescent boy in a Yoda mask taken in by the group; picked Erica as his parent figure over Tandy.

characters.name: Pamela Brinton
characters.line: Wealthy socialite who survived years in a private underground bunker with her dog; just killed Pat to save the group and joined them on the yacht.

beats.label: S4 · Pamela takes over
beats.text: Pamela shoots Pat dead and joins the group at sea; she then holds Tandy hostage on a lifeboat and strands the others on a remote island.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Pamela from savior to captor and physically scatters the group as the season opens.

beats.label: S4 · Reunion and Mexico
beats.text: Castaway Glenn, who missed the apocalypse entirely, helps the group reunite with a repentant Pamela; she and Glenn then leave together for the U.S. to search for his kids.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the Pamela threat, removes her from the ensemble, and moves the group south toward Mexico.

beats.label: S4 · Zihuatanejo
beats.text: The survivors move into a Mexican drug lord's mansion in Zihuatanejo; Todd nearly dies of a heart attack from too many energy drinks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New long-term setting for the season; Todd's brush with death reshapes his priorities around family.

beats.label: S4 · Twins and Gail's wedding
beats.text: Carol gives birth to twin girls, Bezequille and baby Mike; Gail and Erica marry, and Todd starts openly wrestling with baby fever.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The family units solidify and Todd's baby fever sets up the season's second-half arc.

beats.label: S4 · Jasper runs, Karl arrives
beats.text: Jasper runs away after the adults fight over him; searching for him, Tandy and Todd find a cannibal named Karl, who is later executed by a booby-trapped Rubik's cube.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Contained Karl arc that shifts the show's tone, and Jasper's estrangement continues through to the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Mike returns
beats.text: Todd and Erica agree to have a baby together; Tandy's brother Mike arrives alive after all — the virus never took him — and Erica soon becomes pregnant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reverses S2's Mike disappearance and locks in a second pregnancy that closes the season's arc.

beats.label: S4 · The colonists emerge
beats.text: Mike's thermal camera finds a warm mass in Tapachula; the group moves to a small house nearby, and 94 people emerge from an underground hatch and surround them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's final image — the small found family is suddenly, massively outnumbered by strangers.

cliffhanger.text: After years of thinking they were among the last people alive, Tandy's small found family — settled at a quiet Mexican homestead — is surrounded by 94 survivors emerging from an underground bunker.
questions: Are these underground survivors friendly or hostile?
How have so many people been living beneath the ground all this time?
What happens now to the tiny world Tandy and Carol built?

characters.name: Phil "Tandy" Miller
characters.line: Settled in a small Mexican homestead with Carol, their twin daughters, and a third baby on the way; a proper family man now.

characters.name: Carol Pilbasian
characters.line: Mother of twins Bezequille and baby Mike, and pregnant with her third; the emotional center of the group.

characters.name: Erica Dundee
characters.line: Pregnant with Todd's baby, mother of Dawn, and married to Gail.

characters.name: Todd Rodriguez
characters.line: Married to Melissa and expectant father with Erica; recovered from a heart attack that reset his priorities.

characters.name: Melissa Chartres
characters.line: Married to Todd and supportive of his baby with Erica; largely recovered from her breakdown.

characters.name: Gail Klosterman
characters.line: Married to Erica and adoptive mother to Carol; the group's de facto doctor.

characters.name: Mike Miller
characters.line: Tandy's brother; returned alive but has since taken the truck to look for his own life elsewhere.
characters.note: Not with the group when the colonists arrive.

characters.name: Jasper
characters.line: Ran away from the group months ago; Melissa left him a self-driving car to rejoin them if he ever wants to.
